title: canny
explanation:
### Description

Canny edge detection pipeline: read an image, smooth, compute gradient, non-maximum suppression, link and threshold edgels, then sub-pixel position.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkGeometryFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGeometryFilter.html) — extracts the outer surface of a dataset.
- [vtkImageCast](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageCast.html) — image cast.
- [vtkImageConstantPad](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageConstantPad.html) — pads an image with a constant value.
- [vtkImageGaussianSmooth](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageGaussianSmooth.html) — smooths an image with a Gaussian kernel.
- [vtkImageGradient](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageGradient.html) — computes the gradient vector of an image.
- [vtkImageLuminance](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageLuminance.html) — image luminance.
- [vtkImageMagnitude](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageMagnitude.html) — image magnitude.
- [vtkImageNonMaximumSuppression](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageNonMaximumSuppression.html) — image non maximum suppression.
- [vtkImageToStructuredPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageToStructuredPoints.html) — image to structured points.
- [vtkLinkEdgels](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLinkEdgels.html) — link edgels.
- [vtkPNMReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPNMReader.html) — pnm reader.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkStripper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStripper.html) — creates triangle strips and/or polylines from polygonal data.
- [vtkSubPixelPositionEdgels](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSubPixelPositionEdgels.html) — sub pixel position edgels.
- [vtkThreshold](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkThreshold.html) — extracts cells whose scalar values satisfy a threshold criterion.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
